voice_policy: Both sources were already consumed in development. Never use these files or voices as fresh acceptance or return them to training.

phrases.command: Hey Willow, turn on the light.
Hey Nicks, turn on the light.
Hi E S P, turn on the light.

literal_text_policy: Nyx uses the documented Nicks TTS alias; ESP is explicitly spelled. Text intention is not a validated pronunciation label.
source_generation: macOS say, installed voice, native default rate, complete AIFF; no playback, trimming, gain, speed or pitch adjustment

render.resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly on native int16/32768 as float64; rint and saturate to PCM16

threshold_selection: none; unchanged mode defaults, not matched confidence scales or equal population FAR
lifecycle: Existing guarded native P4 runner: create, fixed zero prime, full PCM including native silence, final partial chunk padded by firmware, destroy, per clip.
analysis: Retain every clip/event and separately count any event and post-lead event by intended target, voice and form. Cross phrases are diagnostic negatives for each official arm. No common confusers or continuous background, so no FAR estimate. No keyword-end annotations or true latency estimate. Report compute time separately from UART transfer.
failure_policy: Keep all outputs, missing detections and transport errors. Never retry, regenerate, replace a voice, tune a threshold or drop a clip to improve scores. Incomplete transfer/restoration cannot become a valid combined result.
hardware: Only the verified USB development P4; guarded active-slot write and restoration. Dining-room production panel excluded. No microphone or speaker use.
limitations: Small consumed synthetic-source diagnostic only. It can establish actual speech detect calls and sample/CRC integrity on P4. It cannot establish trained-method quality, equal-FAR superiority, natural-user recognition, keyword-end latency, acoustic behavior or whole-app voice acceptance. The official Willow / custom Willow / matched custom Nyx experiment remains separate.
